result.requirement: The system shall automatically assign incoming orders to the nearest Store Partner that has sufficient Real-Time Inventory Snapshot and available capacity.
result.business_need: The business requires instant, optimal allocation of orders to physical nodes to minimize delivery time and prevent inventory overselling.
functional_behaviour: The system shall calculate the distance between the customer location and all eligible Store Partners.
The system shall validate that the selected Store Partner has sufficient stock for every item in the Order Request.
The system shall create a Fulfillment Task linked to the assigned Store Partner and Delivery Assignment.
The system shall update the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to reflect the reserved quantities immediately.
The system shall notify the Store Partner of the new Fulfillment Task via the assigned Delivery Slot.
related_information_requirements: The specific list of items selected by the customer, their quantities, unit prices, and any special handling notes or delivery preferences provided by the customer.
The current, validated quantity of each sellable item (SKU) at a specific store location, including status flags for availability, partial stock, or temporary unavailability.
The system-generated assignment linking a specific order to a designated store partner and a specific time window for preparation and dispatch.
business_rules: An order must only be assigned to a store if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows available quantity greater than or equal to the requested quantity for all items.
If no store has sufficient inventory for the complete order, the system must not assign the order and must flag it for manual review.
The system must prioritize the nearest store based on the shortest estimated preparation and dispatch time.
Inventory quantities reserved by an automatic assignment must be immediately deducted from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to prevent overselling.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer places an Order Request with items available at multiple Store Partners
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system assigns the order to the nearest Store Partner with sufficient stock and creates a Fulfillment Task

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer places an Order Request where no Store Partner has sufficient stock for all items
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system does not assign the order and flags it for manual review without creating a Fulfillment Task
